queries.compiledQueryString:
select ingredient, average_sleep_point, count_ingredient
from (select
  *,
  '/users/${params.user_hash_id}/ingredient/' || ingredient as ingredient_link
from motherduck.food_table_ingredients_flat_prediction_average
where user_hash_id = '${params.user_hash_id}'
  and ('${inputs.model_filter}' IN ('', 'undefined', 'null') OR model_name = '${inputs.model_filter.value}')
  and count_ingredient >= ${inputs.min_ingredient_count}
  and ingredient is not null and ingredient != '')
order by average_sleep_point desc limit 10

select 'I have been tracking my food intake and recording ingredients, along with a self-assessment of how sleepy I feel after eating. What can be in common in these ingredients that make me want to sleep? (Lower scores = less impact/better, higher scores = greater impact/worse. Observation count = how many times I recorded food containing this ingredient - higher counts indicate more reliable data.) Please also give me a few recommendations on how to tweak my food choices to test if this assumption is correct. ' ||
       string_agg(ingredient || ' - score: ' || round(average_sleep_point, 2)::text || ' - observation count: ' || count_ingredient::text, ', ' order by average_sleep_point desc) as prompt
from (select ingredient, average_sleep_point, count_ingredient
from (select
  *,
  '/users/${params.user_hash_id}/ingredient/' || ingredient as ingredient_link
from motherduck.food_table_ingredients_flat_prediction_average
where user_hash_id = '${params.user_hash_id}'
  and ('${inputs.model_filter}' IN ('', 'undefined', 'null') OR model_name = '${inputs.model_filter.value}')
  and count_ingredient >= ${inputs.min_ingredient_count}
  and ingredient is not null and ingredient != '')
order by average_sleep_point desc limit 10)
